page.title: Tables
page.intro: This outlet's areas, layouts and tables. Their statuses follow the cashier's sales.
page.noAreas: No areas yet. Create one first, such as Indoor or 2nd floor, then add its tables.
page.noAreasView: This outlet has no table areas yet.

mode.title: Dine-in mode
mode.legend: How the cashier records where dine-in customers sit
mode.tableHint: The cashier picks a table from the layout, if needed.
mode.numberHint: Customers take a number stand. The cashier types its number, and a waiter brings the order there.

confirm.bodyTable: From the next sale on, the cashier picks a table from the layout for dine-in orders, if needed, and types no stand number.
confirm.bodyNumber: From the next sale on, the cashier types the stand's number for every dine-in order and picks no table. The areas, layouts and tables stay.

done.table: This outlet now seats its customers at tables.
done.number: This outlet now uses number stands.

mode.numberNotice: This outlet uses number stands: the cashier types the stand's number and picks no table. The areas, layouts and tables below stay, for seating at tables again.

layout.title: {{area}} layout
layout.label: Layout of the {{area}} area
layout.wideOnly: Layouts are arranged on a screen 840 px wide or more, such as a tablet in landscape or a computer.

list.title: Tables in {{area}}
list.empty: No tables in this area yet.

form.nameHint: A number or a name, such as A1 or Terrace 2. Up to 30 characters, unique in this outlet.
form.moveHint: Moving it to another area takes it off the old area's layout. Place it again on the new area's layout.
form.active: Active: the cashier can pick it
form.created: Table {{name}} added. Place it on the layout with Arrange layout.

activate.title: Activate table {{name}}?
activate.body: The cashier can pick this table again.

deactivate.title: Deactivate table {{name}}?
deactivate.body: The table stays on the layout, greyed out, but the cashier can't pick it. It can be activated again at any time.
deactivate.bodyOccupied: Customers are seated at this table, so it goes inactive once the cashier taps Release Table. From then on the cashier can't pick it until it's activated again.

delete.title: Delete table {{name}}?
delete.body: The table leaves the layout and the cashier. Sales that used it keep its name.
delete.occupied: Customers are seated at this table, so it can't be deleted yet. Release it at the cashier first.

areas.title: Areas
areas.intro: The order here is the cashier's order of areas. Each area has a layout of its own.
areas.empty: No areas yet. Areas group tables, such as Indoor, Outdoor or 2nd floor.

form.nameHint: Up to 50 characters, unique in this outlet.

delete.title: Delete area {{name}}?
delete.body: The area and its layout leave the list and the cashier.
delete.notEmpty_one: This area still holds {{count}} table. Move it to another area, or delete it first.
delete.notEmpty_other: This area still holds {{count}} tables. Move them to another area, or delete them first.

editor.title: Arrange the {{area}} layout
editor.intro: Move, resize and turn tables and decorations on the 48 × 32 grid. Changes reach the cashier once saved.
editor.narrow: The layout editor needs a screen 840 px wide or more. Open this page on a tablet in landscape or on a computer.
editor.keys: Pick a table or decoration, then: arrows move it, Shift+arrows resize it, R turns it 90°, Delete takes it off the layout, Esc unpicks it.
editor.saved: Layout saved. The cashier sees it from now on.
editor.discardBody: The layout goes back to the last version saved.
editor.unsaved: There are changes not saved yet.
editor.overlap: Tables {{names}} are on top of one another. Move one of them before saving.
editor.reloaded: The latest layout is loaded. Your earlier changes weren't saved.
editor.leaveBody: Layout changes not saved yet will be lost.
editor.nothingSelected: Pick a table or decoration on the layout to set its place, size, turn and shape.
editor.decorationSides: Decorations are 1 cell up to the layout's width.
editor.allPlaced: Every table of this area is on the layout.
editor.newTables: New tables are added on the Tables page, then placed here.
editor.decorationsHint: Markers only, not tables. They may lie under tables.

schedules.title: Table schedules
schedules.intro: Tables go out of service on their own during their schedules, such as for an event or a renovation. Times in {{zone}}, this outlet's time zone.
schedules.createIntro: The tables picked are inactive at the cashier from the start to the end.
schedules.closed: This schedule is finished or cancelled, so it can't change any more.

form.titleHint: Such as Office party or Terrace renovation. Up to 100 characters.
form.zone: In {{zone}} ({{timeZone}}), this outlet's time zone. The start can't be in the past, and the end comes after the start.
form.startPast: The start can't be before now.
form.tablesHint: Pick the tables one by one, or all of an area's tables at once.
form.noTables: This outlet has no tables yet. Add them on the Tables page first.
form.ongoing: This schedule is ongoing, so its tables are inactive now. Its start may stay as it is.

overlap.title: Overlaps another schedule at the same tables:
overlap.body: The schedule can still be saved. A table they share is inactive while either of them is ongoing.

cancel.title: Cancel schedule {{title}}?
cancel.body: This schedule won't take its tables out of service. It stays saved, as history.
cancel.bodyOngoing: This schedule is ongoing: its tables can be picked at the cashier again at once. It stays saved, as history.
